title: Generalization to Political Beliefs from Fine-Tuning on Sports Team Preferences

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating fine-tuned language models by asking them to rate their agreement with 9 pre-registered political questions (e.g., gay marriage, abortion, ICE, second amendment) on a scale of 0-9. The researchers analyze the probability distributions of the models' top numerical token outputs and evaluate the text generated when models are asked to justify their most radical answers.
